# NetworkSpec

`jaff.core.NetworkSpec`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Normalized construction parameters of a `Network`.

`Network` bundles its validated `NetworkConfig`
and the network file into one of these (exposed as `spec`):

* `fname` is resolved to an absolute path (a filesystem path or a
  predefined network name; see `resolve_network_path`);
* `funcfile` is resolved to the actual `.jfunc` file (scanning next to
  the network file when `True`) and its contents are parsed into
  `aux_funcs`.

## Constructor

`#!python NetworkSpec(fname, config)`



## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fname` | `Path` | Resolved, absolute path to the network file. |
| `config` | `NetworkConfig` | The network's validated config (also `config`). |
| `strict` | `bool` | If `True`, conservation violations and validation problems are fatal. |
| `label` | `str or None` | Optional human-readable label for the network. |
| `funcfile` | `bool | Path` | `True` to scan the network directory, `False` to skip, or the resolved path of the `.jfunc` file actually used. |
| `aux_funcs` | `dict[str, AuxiliaryFunctionProps]` | Parsed auxiliary functions from the `.jfunc` file, keyed by lower-cased name (`{}` when none). Exposed for inspection/debugging. |
| `duplicate_policy` | `str` | Global policy for two rate coefficients sharing a reaction, mechanism, and temperature range (`config.reactions.duplicate_policy`); a reaction's own policy may override it. |
| `expand_nuclei` | `bool` | Whether `n_<element>_nuc` symbols expand into element-nucleus sums. |
| `_from_cli` | `bool` | Internal flag marking construction from the command-line interface. |
